text_block_list.text: One day off, during a visit to the shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… While the variety of essential oils is extensive, the crucial botanical base oil is lacking.
It appears they prioritized fragrance over cosmetic efficacy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the baobab seed oil product from earlier is preferable, yet…
considering the absorption rate, the ingredient balance leaves something to be desired… Mmh…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…Gah?!
T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
W-What brings you here… Well, shopping, obviously.
Still, what an improbable coincidence…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…I was comparing various hair oils.
The bottle I'm currently using is almost empty, you see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I figured I would check if any new products had been released.
Even within the same line, formulas are frequently revised as research advances.
choice_data_list: You pay a lot of attention to that, huh.
You pay a lot of attention to that, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well… as you can see, my hair troubles are never-ending.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…Is it not obvious at a glance?
My hair… well, it expands with extreme ease.

Her hair certainly looked fluffy, but it didn't seem unusually noticeable.
As I wondered why she was so overly concerned about it—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…Trainer. You aren't under the mistaken impression that
my hair naturally stays in this state without any intervention, are you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I put maximum effort into maintaining it. Every single day, I apply anti-frizz
styling agents, not to mention my rigorous nightly haircare regimen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Trainer… even that falls woefully short.
Because my hair is, without exaggeration—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—A catastrophic composite of wavy and helical hair!
A hyper-frizzy mess that makes even professional stylists throw their hands up in despair…!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. While it may not be a standard clinical term,
my hair texture is so anomalous that I have no choice but to describe it as such!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've tried commercial products, formulated my own treatments, and even dabbled
in the taboo known as Tachyon! And yet, there is zero perceptible improvement!
choice_data_list: (Did I just flip a weird switch in her…?!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The agony begins the very moment I open my eyes each morning.
Have you ever bolted upright in bed because you were nearly suffocated by your own hair?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
During the rainy season, the situation turns dire! For me, hair is not some
toy meant for whimsical styling! No, it is an adversary—an enemy to be vanquished—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—People flippantly suggest cutting it short! A catastrophic blunder!
Do you have any idea how maddening it is when it balloons around your face?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't keep it long out of vanity! It is a calculated compromise—leveraging gravity to weigh
it down, or tying it back! Yet naturally—

For a good while after that,
Biwa Hayahide continued to vent her bitter grievances against her hair texture…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—*Sigh*… How many times have I wished
I had sleek, straight hair like Brian's?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I still remember the sheer shock when I first tied her hair as a child.
Smooth, perfectly aligned strands running effortlessly through my fingers… I cried out in disbelief that we shared the same genetics!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In my childish frustration, I caked my hair in Father's pomade and tied it up…
Naturally, it yielded none of Brian's silky glide. It was utter despair…!

…Picturing a young Biwa Hayahide slathering herself in pomade
was so adorable that I couldn't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
W-What is so amusing?!
I am discussing a grave matter here!
choice_data_list: I just thought it's amazing how hard you work at it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, miss~? You seem to have been pondering for quite a while.
May I be of any assistance to you today~?!

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but I couldn't help overhearing! It sounds like you're having quite a struggle
with your hair care routine. If that's the case, our store's—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
N-No, apologies.
We are quite alright.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, let us relocate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for earlier. When it comes to my hair,
I… well, I tend to hold a rather passionate grudge.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even so, losing my composure and ranting in public like that…
I showed you a truly disgraceful side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Eh…

Constantly striving for improvement, never giving up no matter how many setbacks occur.
I told her that this story was proof of just how admirably dedicated she is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…Nonsense. I only experiment because it poses a tangible hindrance.
Had I been blessed with decent hair to begin with, I wouldn't have needed to suffer so.
choice_data_list: But all that trial and error made you who you are today.
But all that trial and error made you who you are today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That… may indeed be true. Perhaps grappling with my hair
is precisely what instilled this stubborn tenacity in me.
choice_data_list: See? It's not entirely a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…Is that not merely hindsight bias?
You are severely downplaying the grueling process of swallowing that bitter pill.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you have a rather peculiar perspective on things.
Quite different from mine… which is likely why I find myself wanting to discuss matters with you.

Biwa Hayahide's expression softened.
It seemed my words had reached her heart. In that case—
choice_data_list: Besides, your fluffy hair looks wonderful.
Besides, your fluffy hair looks wonderful.

text_block_list.text: …I decided to share my honest thoughts, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…I cannot simply let that remark slide.
I appreciate the sentiment, and I do not reject your personal aesthetic taste.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, if that is your conclusion after hearing everything I just explained…
I am compelled to inform you that your calculation is fundamentally flawed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It seems we must debate this subject again, starting from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There is no escape. As my trainer,
I need you to understand my plight better than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, let us sit down properly and go through the comprehensive report of my life's struggle.
You will indulge me, won't you?

We moved to a café afterwards, where she lectured me on her ultimate "Theoretical Framework of Frizzy Hair"…
And I feel like… I finally understood her feelings. Sort of.
